config_por_ciclo.sql: SELECT DISTINCT d.cycle_id,v.id AS config_version_id,v.settings->'ads_pause_economica' AS pause_economica FROM decision d JOIN config_version v ON v.id=d.config_version_id WHERE d.decided_at >= '2026-10-05' AND d.decided_at < '2026-11-04' ORDER BY d.cycle_id,v.id

decisiones_candidatos.sql: SELECT d.id,d.cycle_id,d.ad_entity_id,d.kind,d.decided_at,d.window_start,d.window_end,d.inputs FROM decision d WHERE d.ad_entity_id=ANY(%s) AND d.decided_at >= '2026-10-05' AND d.decided_at < '2026-11-04' ORDER BY d.cycle_id,d.ad_entity_id

ciclos.sql: SELECT id,platform,status,notes FROM optimizer_cycle WHERE started_at >= '2026-10-05' AND started_at < '2026-11-04' AND platform IS NOT NULL ORDER BY id

identidades_actuales.sql: SELECT e.id,e.kind,e.external_id,e.parent_id FROM ad_entity e WHERE e.id=ANY(%s)

tablas_historicas.sql: SELECT table_name,column_name FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_schema='public' AND (table_name ILIKE '%state%' OR table_name ILIKE '%goal%' OR table_name ILIKE '%report%' OR table_name ILIKE '%descarg%') ORDER BY table_name,ordinal_position

reportes_fuente.sql: SELECT o.ad_entity_id,o.source_report_id,min(o.metric_date) AS desde,max(o.metric_date) AS hasta,min(o.observed_at) AS observado,a.profile_id,a.report_name FROM ads_metric_observation o LEFT JOIN ads_report_result a ON a.source_report_id=o.source_report_id AND a.status='written' WHERE o.ad_entity_id=ANY(%s) AND o.observed_at >= '2026-10-05' AND o.observed_at < '2026-11-04' GROUP BY o.ad_entity_id,o.source_report_id,a.profile_id,a.report_name ORDER BY min(o.observed_at) DESC LIMIT 28
